summary: bash: cd /app && jq $(yq -r '.args[]' /app/jq_args.yaml) "$(yq -r '.filter' /app/jq_args.yaml)" /app/users.json > /app/active_users_report.json; echo "exit=$?"; head -40 /app/active_users_report.json; jq -r 'length' /app/active_users_report.json

bash: cd /app && cat > /app/cmd.sh <<'SH'
jq --indent 2 'map(select(.status == "active") | {user_id: .id, username: .username, email: .email, last_login: (.last_login | split("T")[0]), role_count: ((.roles // []) | length), primary_role: ((.roles // [])[0])}) | sort_by(.username)' /app/users.json > /app/active_users_report.json
SH
chmod +x /app/cmd.sh && sh /app/cmd.sh && echo "cmd.sh exit=$?" && jq -e 'all(.[]; .username and .last_login and (.last_login|test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")) and (.role_count == ((.primary_role == null) and 0 or (.role_count)))) ' /app/active_users_report.json >/dev/null; echo "basic=$?"
jq -r 'length, (map(.username) == (map(.username)|sort)), (map(select(.user_id as $i | $i == null))|length)' /app/active_users_report.json
# cross-check against source
jq --slurpfile r /app/active_users_report.json -r '[.[]|select(.status=="active")]|length' /app/users.json
